query: Which material can be used for to improve the ductility and toughness of the HfZrTi high-entropy alloy (HEAs), and why?

generation.predicted_outcome: Improved ductility and toughness of the HfZrTi HEAs
generation.baseline: As-cast or wrought HfZrTi HEAs without Nb addition
